|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Yoda (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V7-L-yoda-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-yoda022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/yoda.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/yoda.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Yoda”. Text: “May deploy to Dagobah. Prevents attacks at same Dagobah site. Your training destiny draws are +1. If Great Warrior on table, once per turn may take your just-drawn destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Immune to attrition.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Yoda (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 4 November 2022<ref name="img-yodaa57375e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/yoda.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5 commit a57375e] (4 November 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/yoda.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Yoda” → “Yoda” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image.
